description: Record task completion for learning Use when native Bash hooks (via Claude Code's settings.json) are wrong because you need Ruflo-side state — pattern persistence, neural training signals, model-routing learning, cost tracking, audit chain. For one-off shell commands, plain Bash hooks are fine.

agent.description: Agent that completed the task. An empty string is treated as omitted. 1-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - . : (first char alphanumeric or _); not __proto__, constructor or prototype. Must be a registered native ID, not a host path such as /root/x.

agentRole.description: Role for role-local pheromone normalization (default agent)

consensusAlignment.description: Agreement with accepted swarm consensus in [0,1] (default quality)

depth.description: Chain depth from root lead session (0 = lead, 1+ = subagent). Used by ADR-147 P3 depth-aware guardrail.

duration.description: Observed task duration in milliseconds (used by pheromone-adaptive topology)

latencyBudgetMs.description: Latency budget used to normalize duration (default 60000ms)

parentAgentId.description: ID of the parent agent (from Claude Code's parent_agent_id OTel span tag / x-claude-code-parent-agent-id header). Omit for top-level work. 1-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - . : (first char alphanumeric or _); not __proto__, constructor or prototype. Must be a registered native ID, not a host path such as /root/x.

patterns.description: Learned patterns to retain; successful tasks with quality >= 0.9 may create reusable skills

storeDecisions.description: Also store routing decision in memory DB

task.description: Task description text (used for learning keyword extraction)

taskId.description: Task identifier. 1-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - . : (first char alphanumeric or _); not __proto__, constructor or prototype. Must be a registered native ID, not a host path such as /root/x.

name: hooks_post-task
